newsitem.title: USA: Diamond Home Q1 sales below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Diamond Home Q1 sales below expectations.

text.p: Diamond Home Services Inc said Tuesday its first quarter sales were about 10 percent below its expectations due to adverse weather conditions in Florida and throughout the northern portion of the U.S.

The home contractor company also said operating margins were down in the quarter due to investment in hiring and training additional sales people, increasing the number of installers, and adding several senior management personnel.
Operating income for the quarter was $34,000, compared to $714,000 a year ago.
The company today reported net income of $155,000, or $0.02 a share on 9.2 million shares outstanding in the first quarter, compared to $349,000, or $0.06 a share on 6.3 million shares a year ago.
Diamond Home shares were down 5-5/8 at 8-3/4.
